utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's go over the plan for the repair drive. Are we still meeting at your garage at 2?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually, it's at Sam's garage, not mine. But yes, 2 PM works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right, Sam's garage. I've got it noted. See you there at 2.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I almost forgot my toolbox in the garage! Good thing I brought it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad you remembered—that'll come in handy for Saturday's repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I sure hope Tess brings that soldering iron for Gus's blender. That thing's been on the fritz for weeks!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Ira and Jules are coming to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure about Ira and Jules, but I know Dane has some backup plans.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought Ira and Jules were definitely coming? Are they not?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm bringing my old toaster to the repair drive. Tess is bringing one too, and Oren will be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, so we've got both of you with toasters, and Oren early to set up. Rosa's cleared her whole Saturday too, so we'll be well-staffed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great that Rosa can join too! Sounds like the drive will be a success.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, so the repair drive's on Saturday, right? I'll try to stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's right! Rosa's bringing tool kits and Oren's got a toolbox. I heard Opal even mapped out spots that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds like we've got all the tools covered then. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a basic toolkit and some spare parts ready for the drive tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Cleo! I'm bringing my blender. Have you told Tess and Nell about the drive yet? I know Tess has an old toaster she wants to fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I already spoke with Tess—she's bringing her toaster. And Nell mentioned she has one too, so they're both set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm glad you're interested, Dane. We could really use an extra hand on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I've got a wrench in the trunk I can bring along—let me know if there's anything else I should grab.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's perfect, Dane! A wrench will come in handy. If you have any tape or spare screws, those would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Vik, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I'll be setting up early if you need any help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'll be there early too. So you're bringing tools, Opal has her repair map, Cleo is bringing tools and parts, and Jules will attend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be gathering tools with Eli. See you early Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive still set for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's still on. I'll be there, but I might have to come late and leave early.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Ira's got the parts ordered, right? And Jules has the skills list ready?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it's on Saturday and I've mapped out all the spots needing repairs. I'll share the map with Rosa and Jules soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Opal. I'll be there to help with whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey! Jules is working on a survey and chatting with neighbors, so we'll have a clear plan soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds like we're well-equipped for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, with Gus's blender and Nell's toaster, we should have enough to fix. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you Saturday! I'll make sure Cleo brings her toolkit and spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive is still on Saturday, right? I just want to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! Saturday it is. I'm bringing my tool kit and my soldering iron—Gus's blender won't fix itself!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Phew, okay. Just checking, you know how things can change last minute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a basic toolkit and some spare parts ready for the repair drive. What about you, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a bunch of tools ready to lend out, and Leo's gonna fix my blender while we're at it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Nice, and I heard Nell and Tess are bringing their old toasters too, so we'll have plenty to work on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Heard Rosa's bringing tool kits for the drive. Good to see everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday's drive will be well-stocked. Gus and Nell are bringing items too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, and I heard Oren's bringing his toolbox. Should cover a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've mapped out all the spots needing repairs; I'll share the map with Rosa and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, we've got supplies too: Quinn's bringing a blender, Cleo has a toolkit, Tess her toaster, and Sam has tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, the drive is set for Saturday, so we're all on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, I’m so glad we’re doing this repair drive! I’ve got my soldering iron ready for Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Sam said he'd come too, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, Sam said he'd be there! He's really handy, I bet he'll help with the tricky stuff. By the way, I'm fixing Gus's blender next week, if you hear anyone else with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad you're bringing the blender, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Happy to help! I heard Cleo's got a toolkit, that'll be useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo's pretty handy with tools, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I've got a wrench in the trunk if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Rosa was bringing the tool kits too, wasn't she? I almost forgot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Rosa's got us covered. So what's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Did you hear Tess is bringing her old toaster to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's nice. I hope someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm actually bringing mine too—maybe they can fix them together!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So the repair drive is this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday, huh? That's what I heard too, but I'll believe it when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's definitely Saturday. I'm marking my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, when are Ira and Jules arriving? I want to make sure we have all the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure exactly, but I'll make sure all the tools are ready when they get here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you check with them and let me know a time? That way I can be sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm trying to match up skills with needs, and you're great with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there. I've got a few small appliances to bring, and I'm happy to help with others too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's wonderful, Mara! I'll add you to the list. Do you know anyone else who might want to join? We could use more hands with electronics.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, but might have to leave early. Just a heads up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, leaving early? That's fine, but could you let me know around what time? Just want to make sure we have enough hands for setup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure yet, sorry. I'll try to stick around as long as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Vik! Just a reminder the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. I'll bring the tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh great! So Cleo and Sam are bringing tools too, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm not sure about Cleo and Sam, actually. Tess is mapping out who has what tools—want me to check with her?
